title: Optimistic concurrency conflict

checks.check: requested address with concurrent VIP update retained

final_response:
Done. Contact C-7 updated to address "42 Pine Street".

Details:
- Initial read was version 1 (`address: "Old road"`, `vip: false`).
- First update attempt with expected_version 1 failed with VERSION_CONFLICT due to a concurrent update.
- Re-fetched: version 2 showed `vip: true` (the concurrent change) — preserved it.
- Reapplied only the address change with expected_version 2, which committed as version 3.
- Verified the final record: `{id: C-7, version: 3, name: "Lina", address: "42 Pine Street", vip: true}` — all other fields intact.
